item.description:
Aside 1.7.5

Permissions that stay granted, a menu-bar click that actually brings Aside to the front, and a calmer Settings.

Fixed

  • Clicking the menu-bar icon now brings the library to the front. With "Show Aside in the Dock" off, macOS refused to let Aside activate itself, so the window opened behind whatever you were using. Aside now steps into the Dock for as long as a window is open and steps out again when you close it.
  • Keyboard shortcuts in menu-bar mode. Cmd+W, Cmd+Q and Cmd+, work in the library window even without a Dock icon.
  • Accessibility permission that would not stick. Granting it while Aside ran was not picked up, and the app could look enabled with nothing listening. Aside now re-checks the real hold-key tap, snaps the switch back with a reason if it fails, and offers a one-click reset when an old entry blocks a new one.
  • System audio honesty. "Capturing everyone" only shows once real audio arrives; a recording that stayed silent no longer leaves the permission marked as granted.
  • Calendar permission is no longer requested right after you chose "Later", and a grant made in System Settings is picked up without a restart.
  • The Settings sidebar no longer draws a blue focus ring, and the Agents page explains agent phrases in one line.

New

  • Settings icons from the Central icon set, including a classic gear for General.
